name: plain-cte-reference
sql: WITH bumped AS (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

name: materialized-cte-reference
sql: WITH bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

name: not-materialized-cte-reference
sql: WITH bumped AS NOT MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

name: plain-cte-omission
sql: WITH bumped AS (UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

name: materialized-cte-omission
sql: WITH bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

name: not-materialized-cte-omission
sql: WITH bumped AS NOT MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

name: mixed-case-materialized-reference
sql: wItH bumped aS mAtErIaLiZeD (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

name: column-list-materialized-reference
sql: WITH bumped(result_id) AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT result_id FROM bumped;

name: second-materialized-reference
sql: WITH seed AS (SELECT 1 AS value), bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

name: recursive-materialized-reference
sql: WITH RECURSIVE bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

name: quoted-cte-name-reference
sql: WITH "materialized" AS (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM "materialized";

name: main-alias-list-after-with
sql: WITH seed AS (SELECT 1 AS value) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' FROM (VALUES (1)) AS materialized(version);

name: main-cast-after-with
sql: WITH seed AS (SELECT 1 AS value) UPDATE items SET name = CAST('changed' AS version);

name: main-alias-list-without-with
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' FROM (VALUES (1)) AS materialized(version);

name: materialized-cte-output-alias
sql: WITH bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING id) SELECT id AS version FROM bumped;

name: ordinality-alias-list-omission
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' FROM unnest(ARRAY[1]) WITH ORDINALITY AS materialized(version, position) RETURNING items.id;

name: ordinality-cte-reference
sql: WITH ordinality AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM ordinality;

name: nested-materialized-cte-reference
sql: WITH a AS MATERIALIZED (WITH b AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT version FROM items) SELECT 1 FROM b) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM a);

name: search-sibling-reference
sql: WITH RECURSIVE walk(n,m) AS (SELECT 1,0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1,m FROM walk WHERE n<2) SEARCH DEPTH FIRST BY n,m SET visit_order, bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version=version+1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

name: search-sibling-omission
sql: WITH RECURSIVE walk(n,m) AS (SELECT 1,0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1,m FROM walk WHERE n<2) SEARCH DEPTH FIRST BY n,m SET visit_order, bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET name='changed' RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

name: cycle-sibling-reference
sql: WITH RECURSIVE walk(n,m) AS (SELECT 1,0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1,m FROM walk WHERE n<2) CYCLE n,m SET cycle_hit USING cycle_path, bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version=version+1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

name: cycle-sibling-omission
sql: WITH RECURSIVE walk(n,m) AS (SELECT 1,0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1,m FROM walk WHERE n<2) CYCLE n,m SET cycle_hit USING cycle_path, bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET name='changed' RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

name: search-cycle-sibling-reference
sql: WITH RECURSIVE walk(n,m) AS (SELECT 1,0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1,m FROM walk WHERE n<2) SEARCH DEPTH FIRST BY n,m SET visit_order CYCLE n,m SET cycle_hit USING cycle_path, bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version=version+1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

name: search-cycle-sibling-omission
sql: WITH RECURSIVE walk(n,m) AS (SELECT 1,0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1,m FROM walk WHERE n<2) SEARCH DEPTH FIRST BY n,m SET visit_order CYCLE n,m SET cycle_hit USING cycle_path, bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET name='changed' RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;
